revised_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: iOS app icon and App Store icon, square 1024x1024
Primary request: Create a polished app icon for a Chinese iOS app named "步履小屋". The app turns daily walking steps from Apple Health into travel tickets that send small animals around the world, then they return with postcards.
Subject: A cozy tiny cabin as the main silhouette, with a warm lit doorway, a curved dotted walking path made of small footprints leading into a folded paper ticket / paper plane shape, and one subtle small cat travel companion with a tiny suitcase near the doorway.
Style/medium: premium watercolor travel-journal illustration, soft pencil outlines, tactile paper texture, gentle handcrafted feel, app-icon-ready rather than detailed scene art.
Composition/framing: centered iconic composition, simple readable shapes, strong silhouette, enough padding for iOS rounded-corner crop, no border, no drop shadow outside the icon.
Lighting/mood: warm, calm, encouraging, cozy evening cabin glow; not gamified or fitness-aggressive.
Color palette: warm cream paper, soft sage green, muted sky blue, honey yellow cabin light, small coral accents; avoid dark blue/purple-dominant palette.
Materials/textures: watercolor wash, subtle paper grain, hand-drawn linework, crisp enough at small sizes.
Text: no text, no letters, no numbers.
Constraints: must read clearly at phone home-screen size; suitable for App Store; no Apple logo, no Health app icon, no brand marks, no realistic humans, no busy background, no photorealism, no watermark.
